items.title: Ford F-Series truck production hits multi-year highs amid sales slump

items.title: NIO Stock Drops. The Weak Chinese Car Market Is Too Much to Overcome.
items.summary: The weak Chinese car market is too much for electric vehicle maker  NIO  to overcome.  Following earnings, Citi analyst Jeff Chung cut his sales estimates and price target to $7.10 from $8.20.  Declines left shares off 41% over the past 12 months.

items.title: Why High-Yield Baby Bonds Offer Income Investors a Rare Opportunity
items.summary: Have a look at an obscure corner of the corporate bond market that is offering high yields and good credit quality.  Yields are higher than those on many preferred stock issues that also trade on the NYSE.
